Legendary Equipment is an Equipment are items with higher rarity in Last Epoch.

## Characteristics[]

Legendary equipment are essentially unique items with up to four additional attributes. Like all uniques, they can carry unique mechanics, implicit stats, and/or affix stats that cannot be attained via regular Crafting. They have a red colored name/border, a unique name, and unique icons/models. When dropped on the ground, they will be indicated by a red beam of light from the sky.

Legendary items can have Legendary Potential, a number which determines the number of transferrable unsealed affixes, when used in the Eternity Cache.

## Limitations[]

Much like Unique equipment, legendary items cannot be used in crafting, meaning it cannot be shattered nor can affixes be attached to them.
